stem: How can the reader tell that attending the picnic is important to Christopher?

options.label: A
options.text: He tries to be very careful when he arrives at school on Friday.

options.label: B
options.text: He invites his friends to sit next to him on the bus ride to school.

options.label: C
options.text: He tells the principal what happened in Mr. Gregg's class.

options.label: D
options.text: He hasn't been to the principal's office this week.
